articleTitle: Fraud Detection and Analysis for Insurance Claim using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Insurance Company working as commercial enterprise from last few years have been experiencing fraud cases for all type of claims. Amount claimed by fraudulent is significantly huge that may causes serious problems, hence along with government, different organization also working to detect and reduce such activities. Such frauds occurred in all areas of insurance claim with high severity such as insurance claimed towards auto sector is fraud that widely claimed and prominent type, which can be done by fake accident claim. So, we aim to develop a project that work on insurance claim data set to detect fraud and fake claims amount. The project implement machine learning algorithms to build model to label and classify claim. Also, to study comparative study of all machine learning algorithms used for classification using confusion matrix in term soft accuracy, precision, recall etc. For fraudulent transaction validation, machine learning model is built using PySpark Python Library.

articleTitle: Effective Software Effort Estimation using Heterogenous Stacked Ensemble
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Software Effort Estimation (SEE) estimates the effort required to complete the project successfully. The accuracy of estimation is directly proportional to the project success. This paper proposes a heterogenous stacked ensemble for effective effort estimation with Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Support Vector Regressor (SVR) as base learners. Further, an empirical comparison is made among the proposed model and base learners to figure out the accuracy of proposed model. Five datasets from PROMISE repository are used and accuracy measures for comparison are MAR (Mean Absolute Error) and MMRE (Mean Magnitude of Relative Error). It is found that proposed model improves the performance by reducing the MAR by 50.4% and MMRE by 54.6% of base models respectively. It can be concluded from the experimental results that the proposed heterogenous stacked ensemble is best performer among the candidate models for SEE statistically.

articleTitle: Vehicle Accident Detection and Prevention using IoT and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Road accidents have become an issue of major concern to the people. This paper presents an accident prevention mechanism developed through alcohol detection using an MQ3 alcohol sensor followed by automatic engine locking. The detection part uses an SW-420 vibration sensor to detect any sort of abnormal vibrations that may occur from a collision. This is accompanied by supervised deep learning CNN algorithms. The accident scene image is captured using a front camera built in the vehicle to be used by the deep learning model for accident prediction. Accident detection is followed by communication to the nearest emergency center using GPS and GSM modules.

articleTitle: LSTM based Synthesis of 12-lead ECG Signal from a Reduced Lead Set
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper presents a patient-specific approach for reconstructing the standard 12-lead ECG from a minimal lead set. The 12-lead ECG signal acquisition impediment using ten electrodes comprises ambulatory monitoring, personalized healthcare, remote healthcare, and pediatric ECG lead placement. Furthermore, concurrently processing signals from multiple electrodes enhances the intricacy as well as the cost. Synthesizing 12-lead ECG from a reduced lead set becomes a better solution. This study proposes a recurrent neural network (RNN) long short-term memory (LSTM) to synthesize standard 12-lead ECG from the three predictor leads. The four performance metrics, namely correlation coefficient (cc), root mean square error (RMSE), and wavelet energy diagnostic distortion (WEDD), are employed to evaluate the performance of the proposed method. The proposed model obtained fine reconstruction quality and achieved better performance than most of the previously established works without compromising diagnostic information.

articleTitle: Decentralized Crowdfunding Platform using Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Crowdfunding is an online cash raising technique which has been started to encourage the ideas of innovative minds of people by investing the required quantity of money on them. Using crowdfunding, people can put resources into spearhead businesses through a platform. The issue faced during the today’s world of crowdfunding technique is that, intermediator doesn't give the assurance to the investor who contributed money for the project and also the investor doesn't have any control over the cash they invested. To overcome this major problem, a blockchain based technique is used to provide a private, secure and decentralized platform for crowdfunding. The main objective is to create a smart contract to let investors contribute to any innovational ideas where the assurance of the money is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Aquila Optimizer based Deep Neural Network for Automatic Diabetic Retinopathy detection and classification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy is a retinal disease that significantly affects working and aged people all over the world. Nowadays, numerous techniques are available for the early detection and diagnosing process which acts as a prevention strategy for visual impairment. Recent researches have provided a cheap way of identification but the execution time required for classifying an optimal output was very high. Therefore, to overcome such shortcomings, this paper proposes four different phases namely the preprocessing, segmentation stage, feature extraction stage as well as classification stage. During preprocessing phase, the images are cropped to eliminate the additional areas and unwanted noise signals are eliminated. Then a modified level set algorithm is employed in segmenting the retinal images from the preprocessed image. Finally, this paper utilizes a deep neural network-based Aquila optimizer (DNN based AO) to classify the retinal images. In addition, this paper utilizes a publically accessible IDRiD dataset containing 516 image sets to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. At last, the experimental evaluations are carried out and the analysis revealed that the performance rate of the proposed approach is high when compared with other existing techniques.

articleTitle: FEM analysis and experiments of a Double-sided Axial Flux Switched Reluctance Motor for two alternative phase winding terminal connections
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper deals with the double-sided axial flux switched reluctance motor (DSAF-SRM) operation for series and parallel electrical connections of the phase winding terminals of the two stators. Its effect on motor performance is thoroughly studied. It is conjectured that the connections have implications with regard to unbalanced magnetic pull (UMP) and torque ripple. The motor under test is a laboratory designed and fabricated 0.75 hp, 24 V, 8S/6R DSAF-SRM. The motor performances with both the electrical connections have been analysed in FEM which is next validated experimentally also. The results are found to be in good mutual agreement.

articleTitle: WaterHCI Part 1: Open Water Monitoring with Realtime Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This is the first of our two accepted papers in this conference so we are presenting it as Part 1 in the new and growing field known as Water-HCI or WaterHCI (Water-Human-Computer Interface/Interaction/Intersection). WaterHCI originated in the 1960s and 1970s as a form of water interaction, water monitoring, water-based augmented reality / extended reality, and the like. Much of this work began with hydraulophones (underwater musical instruments) in the 1960s and underwater Augmented Reality (AR) or eXtended Reality (XR) with the SWIM (Sequential Wave Imprinting Machine) in the 1970s. SWIM is a sensing and meta-sensing (sensing-of-sensing) tool with real-world applications in the XR visualization of otherwise invisible phenomena. In this paper, SWIM is applied to understanding open water, such as at beaches, to realtime understanding of water characteristics, and their spatial variations. A sensor and meta-sensor pod was developed and can be towed behind a swimmer to provide immediate XR feedback of the current water characteristics to enable the swimmer to choose an optimal path to swim. Part 2 of WaterHCI was also developed based on autonomous crafts, drones, and the like to sense water quality and generate an XR "heatmap" that shows spatial variations of water properties such as water temperature, turbidity, conductivity, etc., made visible to a swimmer’s head-up display in realtime.

articleTitle: Review of Battery Charging Methods for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Electric Vehicle industry is having wide acceptance due to its advantages over conventional vehicles. This paper reviews the different types of EV charging method based on the infrastructure, method of power transfer, power levels, and direction of power flow. Charger systems are classified as off-board and on-board chargers and based on the method of power transfer conductive and inductive charging system. Depending on the direction of power flow uni-directional and bi-directional chargers and based on the different Power levels Level 1, 2, 3 Charging. The emerging battery swap method is also discussed.

articleTitle: A Disturbance Observer Based Control for Quadrotor Aircraft Subject to Wind Gusts
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: In this paper, a Disturbance Observer Based Controller (DOBC) is designed for the quadrotor. Unmanned aerial vehicle control becomes more challenging because of its cross coupling and complex dynamics. In addition, external disturbances affecting the system leads to an unstable condition. A Disturbance Observer Based Controller (DOBC) can effectively solve this problem by the estimation and attenuation of external wind disturbances. This work focuses on a linear model of quadrotor aircraft system with external wind disturbances and its effect on the translational motion. A disturbance observer based controller is designed and implemented for the estimation and attenuation of the external disturbances. In addition to this an optimal controller is also designed to analyze the performance of DOBC. Finally MATLAB simulations are conducted to verify the presented approach.

articleTitle: Modelling and Performance Estimation of All Inorganic Double Perovskite Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)

articleTitle: Investigations on Performance Parameters of Hybrid Perovskite Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Hybrid perovskite solar cell is one of the most promising among the third generation solar cells with high power conversion efficiency and low manufacturing cost. The effect of variation in device dimensions on the performance parameters of the solar cell is investigated in this paper. The device dimension under focus is the absorber region width of p-i-n solar cell. The variation of open circuit voltage, closed circuit current density, fill factor and power conversion efficiency is evaluated for the same. From the analysis, it is deduced that an absorber region width of 300nm is the optimal width for maximum power conversion efficiency. Further, the device is evaluated for the optimized absorber region width and different doping concentrations for electron transport and hole transport layers. The higher doping concentrations yield better conversion efficiencies due to the property of greater charge selectivity.

articleTitle: A Single-Phase Hybrid Seventeen Level Multilevel Inverter Topology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Inverters play a major role in electrical field and there have been many advancement in this context. Multilevel inverter is one among them. This study proposes a single phase seventeen level multilevel inverter. Here the dc sources will be coupled in a series/parallel configuration to distribute the load. A couple of switches and voltage sources will be used for producing a larger number of output level voltage. The harmonic content will be reduced by using the technique of hybrid modulation. Comparison in THD value is done for thirteen level and seventeen level topology and THD value improvement can be seen here. The simulation of the inverter is carried out in SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Modelling of Power Flow Dynamics for Congestion Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Increased power demand, poor transmission infrastructure and uncertain renewable generation cause congestion in the power network. Traditionally network congestion is cleared by the system operator by rescheduling generators. Network congestion can be cleared automatically and immediately by a controller. The controller can obtain synchrophasor measurements of line power flow and maintain it at the desired value by controlling some generators in real-time. In this paper, an accurate dynamic model of the line power flow including turbine-governor dynamics is developed. Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) controller is implemented on the developed line power flow model to regulate the line flow at the desired value and the results are compared with the approximate model. The control strategy is validated in the 16-machine 68-bus test system. It has been found on modeling that the approximate model produces optimistic results comparing detail model with constraints.

articleTitle: Design of Computationally Efficient IFIR based Filter Structure for Digital Channelizer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: A low computational complexity digital channelizer is essential for a wide band system. FRM is a widely used method to generate a sharp transition width sub-bands or channels in a digital channelizer. The aim of this work is to design a uniform and non-uniform sharp transition width FIR filter bank with low computational complexity compared to FRM based digital channelizer. The design parameters of the proposed structure are evaluated in an efficient way. The proposed structure is designed based on IFIR filter and complex exponential modulation technique (CEMT). The performance of the proposed structure is demonstrated with the help of an example. Results show that the number of multipliers of the proposed structure is less compared to other existing methods.

articleTitle: Exhibiting the Effect of Time Delays on Load Frequency Control of Multi Area Interconnected Hybrid Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper focuses on revealing the most significant effect of time delays (TDs) on load frequency control (LFC) performance of multi area hybrid power system (MAHPS). Dynamic behavior of MAHPS is examined subjected to the perturbation of 10% step load (10%SLP) on area-1. Conventional PID controller is enacted as secondary regulator rendered optimally using water cycle algorithm (WCA) subjected to the index of integral square error (ISE). However, efficacy PID using WCA is demonstrated with comparative performances of genetic algorithm (GA) and moth flame optimizer (MFO) based PID approaches. Analysis is carried on MAHPS with and without taking TDs into account to exhibit its effect. Finally, effect of TDs on LFC performance is visualized and their importance is clearly demonstrated.

articleTitle: Detailed FEM-based Analysis of Vibration in a 3-phase Switched Reluctance Motor and its Experimental Validation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper deals with FEM-based electro-magnetic and mechanical analysis on a 3 phase, 1 kW, 48 V, 3000 rpm switched reluctance motor laboratory prototype. At first the modal analysis of the individual parts of the motor namely, the stator, rotor, shaft and the frame has been done in order to obtain the dominant natural modes of vibration. Then the static structural analysis is done to determine deformation due to its self-weight. A coupled simulation of electro-magnetic and transient structural is finally performed to estimate the motor deformation during the usual operation. Experiments have been performed to validate the simulation results. A MEMS-based accelerometer has been used to measure the instantaneous acceleration of the motor. The recorded data has been processed to obtain the deformation amplitude which is found to be in good agreement with the FEM-based simulation results.

articleTitle: Alzheimer’s Disease Classification from Cross-sectional Brain MRI using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) comes under the category of neurodegenerative disorder that is incurable. Early diagnosis of AD with proper treatment can help to prevent brain tissue damage. Imaging modalities like MRI plays a vital role in studying AD over the past few decades. Detection of AD using biomarkers with the aid of Deep learning techniques made a remarkable movement in the easy and accurate detection of this disease. The applications of deep learning in the area of biomedical image processing is exponentially growing. An automatic semantic segmentation technique is used here for AD classification. In this study, the Segnet architecture is used for automated segmentation of hippocampal atrophy of brain followed by classification yields an accuracy of 97%, which is a promising result compared with some of the state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Localization Techniques in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are widely used in different applications. They are employed in different regions attached with sensors to observe or to take data from that particular area. The location of the nodes is very much important as in the case of a collective system. Every node deployed to provide a certain set of information which is very much valuable considering the application of a wireless sensor network. Localization can be classified based on range measurement. Range based method make use of distance or time as a computation measure. Range free methods are cost effective because of lesser hardware constraints. Distance velocity hop is a range free technique which uses hop based computation. A distance based localization measures the distance between the nodes and the position of unknown node is estimated. The performance of both the algorithm is compared and the results are analyzed.

articleTitle: Gate Matching Algorithm for Early False Path Detection in Statistical Static Timing Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: In recent years, technology scaling has been most prevalent as it offers many advantages like improved chip performance, device density, decrease in cost etc. Due to this aggressive scaling of process technology, designs have reached sub nano-meter size. In Nano scales, the process variations have more influence which has left Static Timing Analysis (STA) inadequate for analyzing these designs. So, Statistical Static Timing Analysis (SSTA), which is more accurate and faster compared to traditional Static Timing Analysis is widely used. SSTA without false path detection is found to be still pessimistic, estimating delays higher than the actual and consume more time as it considers many false paths during analysis. The paper proposes a novel algorithm that aims at reducing the overestimation of delays and execution time required for the analysis by early detection of false paths in the circuit and eliminating them from further analysis process. The algorithm was coded using the python language and the experiments were carried out on a set of dedicated combinational circuits using a 4 GB RAM, i5 processor. The Execution time, to identify the true longest path after eliminating higher delay false paths using the proposed algorithm is observed to be in the range of 1 second to 7.02 seconds.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Code Hopping Multiple Access using Orthogonal Complementary Codes under Rician Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Code-Hopping multiple access (CHMA) is one of the evolving multiple access techniques offering improved performance in frequency selective fading channels. The existing orthogonal and semi-orthogonal codes are not capable of preserving the orthogonality in multipath channels. In addition, multiple access interference (MAI) and multipath interference (MPI) destroy the orthogonal characteristics of codes resulting in errors during detection. Orthogonal complementary codes (OCCs) possesses ideal autocorrelation and cross correlation characteristics resulting in improved performance compared to Gold codes and Walsh codes in multipath channels. In this paper, we employ OCC for detection of CHMA signals in multipath channels and compare its performance with Gold codes to prove the superiority of OCC. We derive the error rate expressions under Rician fading channels and evaluate the performance of the proposed scheme to show its supremacy compare to conventional systems.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual Processor Based Single Board GNSS Receiver Embedded Navigation Computer for Low Cost Launch Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: As space sector becomes more business oriented and space-based services becomees an essential part of daily life, the access to space has to be less expensive. Conventionally MIL-883 qualified electronic components are used for the launch vehicle avionics, which is manifold costlier, bulkier and power consuming compared to industrial grade electronics. The low-cost launch vehicles with industrial grade electronics for onboard avionics systems with higher level of functional abstraction is becoming a new standard for the upcoming space vehicles. In a step towards designing and realizing low-cost unified navigation computer for GNSS receiver functions, Inertial Navigation processing and Integrated navigation functions, a single board computer is designed with industrial standard electronics. The cost of the system is reduced by selecting highly reliable industrial standard electronic components while incorporating all fault tolerant pedigree of conventional avionics systems. The navigation computer includes an RF front end for processing GNSS signals, an FPGA based GNSS correlator section, a processor for doing GNSS receiver functions, an FPGA based communication module and a second processor for doing Inertial Navigation and Integrated navigation functions. A novel Inter-processor communication scheme is designed, which ensures flawless data transfer between the processors. Necessary simulation interfaces are also designed to do ground-based hardware/processor in loop simulations. The hardware and software design, realization and integration are completed and the system is qualified for launch vehicle applications. The overall hardware and software design of the system is covered in this paper along with the Inter-processor communication scheme

articleTitle: Residual Network based Single Object Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: In this paper, we propose the idea of single object tracking using RESNET-101. The proposed Residual Network based Single Object Tracking (R-SOT) consists of the basic idea of supervised learning. The frames are given as an input to the tracker and the tracker predict the bounding boxes and place them on a specified object and move that bounding box with that object in the entire frames of video. The detection of bounding boxes from RESNET-101 is performed by using Region Based Convolutional Neural network (RCNN) Object Detector. The performance of the proposed tracker is checked using Online Object Tracking Benchmark(OOTB) dataset. Test Results show that the proposed tracker is able to track the single object with high precision.

articleTitle: Gain Scheduled LQR Control of a Two Wheeled Mobile Robot with Heavy Payloads
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Two Wheeled Mobile Robots (TWMRs) are popularly used as human transporters and mobile manipulators due to their high maneuverability and compact design. TWMRs can also be used as an easier luggage transportation vehicle in constrained spaces. Proper stabilization of the vehicle is crucial when different payloads are added to the system. In this paper, the problem of stabilizing a TWMR with varying payload is addressed. The TWMR is modelled as a mobile inverted pendulum. During dynamic loading, the inverted pendulum mass and length will be varying and hence the stability of the vehicle will be disturbed. A fixed gain LQR controller will not be able to stabilize the system when subjected to a varying payload. A gain scheduled LQR controller is proposed to achieve balancing of TWMR under varying loads. Simulation studies show that the proposed gain scheduled LQR controller scheme is successful in stabilizing the TWMR for a wide range of payload variations.

articleTitle: Design considerations for selecting GNSS antenna mounting location in launch vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper describes the design considerations for selecting GNSS antenna mounting location in launch vehicles. Antenna mounting location and configuration of antenna system has a direct impact on the visibility of GNSS satellites during the launch vehicle ascent. Differences in types of orbits of different satellite navigation constellations pose a challenge in finding an antenna mounting location suitable for all constellations. In this paper, design considerations for finding antenna mounting location suitable for reception of GPS and NavIC signals are explored in detail. Simulations are carried out taking into consideration the launch vehicle trajectory, orbital information of satellites and receive antenna pattern, and using the receiver hardware. The simulation results are a good indication of expected satellite visibility during the actual launch and a comparison with the flight results are carried out. In summary, the design considerations explored in this paper present an effective approach in selecting GNSS antenna mounting location for launch vehicles

articleTitle: Emotion Classification using Physiological Signals: A Recent Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The diverse forms of emotions practiced by human beings such as happiness, sadness, anger, fear point to the state of mental, and social welfare of an individual. The sentiments can be noticed through imaging techniques, voice signals, and biosignals. Facial signs may not give a strong sign of the state of emotions since a person can fleece the emotions. The voice signals direct untrue emotions owing to the differences in the tone of the people. The biosignals like ECG, EEG, galvanic skin resistance(GSR), skin temperature, respiration rate are initiated from the autonomic nervous system. Hence the emotions sensed using the biosignals cannot be misread. We have conducted a recent survey on classifying the emotions detected using ECG & GSR signals, focusing on the various feature selection & classification methods.

articleTitle: Transfer learning for Speech Based Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Speech emotion recognition has an important role in computer-mediated human communication. One of the major challenges in speech-based emotion recognition is data scarcity. Emotions of spontaneous speech in real scenarios and non-labeled speech data emotions are difficult to identify. Transfer learning is an effective way to address challenges related to data scarcity and the lack of human labels. This work uses the transfer learning method based Time Delay Neural Network (TDNN), which uses the knowledge learned from one domain and applies it to another domain with fewer data. Malayalam is one of the less-resourced languages in the case of emotional speech data. Hence the emotional recognition from this is difficult. Transfer learning can be used to identify emotions in languages with non-labeled samples due to the similarity in features corresponding to the emotions. The main reason behind such a technique is that people may share similar characteristics when expressing a given emotion. TDNN was first trained in the source domain to retain and reuse that knowledge to identify the emotions in the target domain. In this work, TDNN uses the RAVDESS English dataset as a source and the Malayalam Speech Corpus in Indic TTS Malayalam dataset as a target to identify the emotions in the Malayalam dataset. The performance of the TDNN based system was compared with a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) network to study the performance enhancement due to transfer learning. The experimental results show that the accuracy of detection has been enhanced from 57.67% to 88.89%.

articleTitle: Shallow SegNet with bilinear interpolation and weighted cross-entropy loss for Semantic segmentation of brain tissue
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Semantic segmentation using deep learning techniques is now state-of-the-art in medical image segmentation, especially for brain Magnetic Resonant images (MRI). SegNet, a fully convolutional neural network architecture, is widely used for image segmentation. However, it is less frequently used than the other popular competing approach of U-Net, for brain MRI segmentation. A few researchers have proposed a fusion of SegNet and U-Net architectures to combine their desirable properties for performance gains. In this paper, a different direction of research is undertaken. A simpler yet more accurate shallow SegNet architecture is proposed to yield promising segmentation performance on brain MRI. The proposed architecture uses a bilinear interpolation upsampling mechanism instead of max unpooling. Further, a modified cross-entropy loss is employed that is weighted differently for different classes. The class imbalance problem is effectively overcome using this weighted cross-entropy loss. Performance comparison of the proposed architecture with existing works indicates that the average dice factor is enhanced to 0.83 with an improvement of 0.11 over the baseline SegNet. It is demonstrated that the proposed shallow SegNet is a simpler yet more accurate model compared to both the existing SegNet and U-Net and could serve as a baseline for fine-grained image segmentation tasks.

articleTitle: A Novel State Space Model of an Interleaved Boost Converter operating over a wide range of duty ratio
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Interleaved Boost Converter is a simple and efficient circuitry that boosts DC voltage with reduced current ripples. However, the detailed modelling of this converter especially for analyzing its operation over the entire duty ratio range has not been described in the existing literature. This paper presents the complete design procedure for developing the state-space model of a 2-phase interleaved boost converter starting from the fundamental circuit equations. The small-signal perturbed model formulation is also described which is instrumental in developing control strategies that can make the system stable in closed loop. The impact of duty ratio on the converter model, while operating at duty ratios above and below 0.5, is also detailed. The modeling procedure described in this work can be extended to converters of this type with any number of phases.

articleTitle: Maximizing Strategy in Customer Segmentation Using Different Clustering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Customer Segmentation is very important in marketing because it helps a manager know who is the potential customer and helps in avoiding pursuing the wrong customers. Customer segmentation is grouping the customers based on their age, gender, annual income, location and so on. It helps the companies to understand the customers needs and tries to satisfy them. It aims to create a relationship with the most profitable customers by designing the most appropriate marketing strategy. In this study, we use K-means clustering, DBSCAN and Affinity propagation for segmenting the customers and will make a comparison on these different clustering approaches.

articleTitle: Radial force reduction of Switched Reluctance Motor for EV application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper presents the radial force reduction techniques of Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) for Electric Vehicle (EV) application. Even though SRM has more advantages over other electrical machines, the higher torque ripple limits its application in the automobile industry. The radial component of the electromagnetic force generates torque ripple and vibration. In this paper, two different geometrical modifications, SRM with circular holes and SRM with rectangular windows on the rotor along the axial direction are proposed to reduce the radial force. The geometrical parameters of the SRM are obtained from the basic output equation. The static and dynamic analysis of conventional and proposed SRM configurations are presented and reported the results. Mass and mass moment of inertia of the motor are the key factors for the EV application. The mass of the rotor is calculated analytically and compared with the simulation results. The FEA analysis of conventional and modified 4 phase 8/6, SRM configurations is carried out using the electromagnetic design tool MagNet to verify the analytical results.

articleTitle: Analyzing Tone of the Annual Report - An Indian Context
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Investment is a present-day pledge of money or an asset in the hope that it will bring benefits in the future. Investors have a wide variety of instruments to invest. Equity shares are one of the instruments. Companies sell their equity shares in the primary market, and investors can resell it in the secondary market. In India, it is mandatory for all companies to publish annual reports. The annual report is composed of the director’s report, auditors report, financial statements, and notes to the accounts. Financial statements are in quantitative form while the director’s report, notes to the accounts and auditors report are in qualitative form. Investors read the annual report and if they found the tone of the annual report to be positive, then they invest else they disinvest. The proposed paper builds the portfolio based on the tone present in the annual report. It also analysis the tone of the companies which are under the supervision of the national stock exchange of India and are yet to be registered. It is interesting to note that out of 123 companies under the supervision, only 7 have a positive tone, 43 are neutral, and 73 companies have a negative tone. The paper also analyzed companies belonging to different sectors. It is observed that information technology companies have a more positive tone than automobile companies. The paper via hypotheses establishes the existence of a positive correlation between the tone of the annual report and the performance of the company.

articleTitle: High Power Microwave Rectifier for Lower Variation to Input Power and Phase
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This work presents a novel high efficiency and low complexity radio frequency (RF) to direct current (DC) rectifier was designed for wireless power transfer (WPT) applications at 2.45 GHz. The proposed circuit is based on a Branch line coupler (BLC) and shunt diode rectifier that maintains high conversion efficiency over a broad range of input power. The circuit has been simulated and optimized with help of Advanced design system (ADS) using a Large signal S-parameter (LSSP) tool on RT/duroid 5880 substrates with h = 0.8 mm and ϵ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf> = 2.2. The reflection coefficient remains less than −15 dB for the complete simulation power range (0 to 36 dBm). The peak power conversion ratio obtained for the designed circuit is 67.19% for input in-phase power equal to 32 dBm. With variation in relative input phase (at the second coupler port) between 0° to 360°, the efficiency remains higher than 50% from 23 to 34 dBm.

articleTitle: Design of Quadrature Mirror Filter using Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Nature-inspired algorithms have been recently identified as efficient methods of solving complex computational problems. The application of these algorithms is being extended also towards solving the problems of signal processing in the digital diaspora. The Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (GOA) is a new development of a nature-inspired algorithm with meta-heuristic features. Quadrature Mirror Filters are very important and useful for multi-rate signal processing. This paper renders an alternate method of designing a quadrature mirror filter bank using the GOA. The performance of this design algorithm is demonstrated and simulation results are compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: On some issues in Kalman filter based trilateration algorithms for indoor localization problem
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Accurate determination of moving object’s location in indoor environment is important to facilitate location based services for cellular phone users. Various techniques such as fingerprinting, pedestrian dead reckoning etc. have been studied in many researches and proven to be effective. Installation of costly hardware equipment and use of complex algorithms in these methods make them difficult to implement in real time situation. Received signal strength based geometrical algorithms have been proven to be economical, but suffer due to degraded quality of signals in indoor environment. Kalman filter based approach can solve the problem by filtering out the noisy signal. Presence of obstacles in the forms of walls, furniture etc. in indoor location makes the tracking dynamics nonlinear which requires a nonlinear variant of Kalman filer to be used. In conventional extended Kalman filter based indoor localization technique, filter algorithms are applied with every stationary access point’s measurements, prior to the application of trilateration algorithm. Application of many filters makes the system computationally expensive. Current work investigates an approach where a single extended Kalman filter algorithm is used. The approach first applies trilateration algorithm on collected measurements of distances of all reachable access points from the mobile object. Then it runs an extended Kalman filter algorithm on the measurement of the access point which is found to be the nearest from the target based on the computation of the previous stage. Simulation results show that, the presented approach exhibits similar performance in comparison with only trilateration method and trilateration method aided with more than one extended Kalman filter based technique.

articleTitle: WaterHCI Part 2: Open water sensing, meta-sensing, and observing with drones and augmented reality
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: WaterHCI (Water-Human-Computer Interface/Interaction/Intersection) is a new field of research that was introduced in our other IEEE SPICES 2022 paper appearing in this conference Proceedings. In this paper, which comprises Part 2 of this 2-paper series, SWIM (Sequential Wave Imprinting Machine), a WaterHCI tool developed in the 1970s, is applied to understanding physical phenomena in air and water, using drones (uncrewed aircraft or ships) for sensing and meta-sensing (the sensing of sensing), as well as to develop an epistemological framework for understanding the world, such as the world of sensing and sensors, as well as the environment, e.g. beach water characteristics, etc.. In Part 1, a sensor and meta-sensor pod was developed for being towed behind a swimmer to provide immediate augmented reality feedback of the current water characteristics to enable the swimmer to choose an optimal path to swim. In this paper (Part 2), this pod is now also used in the context of an autonomous watercraft developed for towing the pod in a pre-determined or adaptive pattern. Thus an augmented reality "heatmap" is developed that shows spatial variations such as water temperature, turbidity, conductivity, etc..

articleTitle: A Secured Key Management Scheme for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks with Modified Montgomery Modular Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Implementing factorization concept in Montgomery Modular Arithmetic improves the efficiency of standard modular arithmetic, which occurs in many cryptographic algorithms that are applied frequently for key management in Mobile Ad Hoc Network (MANET). In this paper Elliptic Curve Cryptography with Diffie Hellman key exchanging mechanism (ECC-DH) is implemented with Modified Montgomery Modular Arithmetic (MMECC-DH) for secure key management and performance enhancement of MANET. Metrics like Key calculation time, Key update time, Packet Delivery Radio, Average Power Consumption per Node, number of cycles per key exchange, Operations per second, processing time and Security Levels of ECC-DH, Montgomery Elliptic Curve Cryptography with Diffie Hellman key exchange (MECC-DH) and MMECC-DH methods are measured in Haswell and Sandy Bridge Architecture based processors.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Machine Learning Algorithms for Cardiac Auscultation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Heart produces basically two types of sounds. The S1 sound and the S2 sound. The S1 sound is the frequency of the heart sound nearly ranging between 30-50 Hz and the S2 sound is the frequency of the second heart sound ranging between 50-80 Hz. Frequency analysis of heart sound is done using different techniques. The abnormality conditions in the heart depends on the split sounds, the murmur and also other changes in the heart sound frequencies. The dataset of these frequencies could be given into different classification algorithms to predict the condition of the patient. This paper derives a study of different supervised learning classification algorithms like Support Vector Machines, K Nearest Neighbors, and Decision Tree on Cardiac Auscultation and to compare them with Artificial Neural Network using Multilayer Perceptron. SVC of SVM stands out as the best classifier with highest scores on accuracy and precision and this technique could be applied to predict the condition of a patient.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of State-of-the-art Image Splicing Localization Methods Using Fully Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Image splicing forgery is one of the significant image manipulations. It is very difficult to find the location of forged portion in a spliced image. Nowadays, deep neural networks have been used to detect and localize image forgeries. In this paper, a brief survey and comparison on splicing localization of images using Fully Convolutional Network (FCN), a deep neural network is presented.

articleTitle: Current Control with Hysteresis Controller and Sliding mode Controller in SRM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Switched reluctance motor drives (SRM) are gaining great acceptance in industry over the past few decades because of its extensive development and design simplicity. SRM is considered as a reliable machine for many applications with low manufacturing cost. A converter is required to drive the switched reluctance motors as they cannot be driven directly from a dc or ac source. A controller is used to track the motor output current with the current command values. This paper presents a comparative study of simulation results of current control of a 6/4 SRM driven by a sliding-mode current controller and hysteresis current controller in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mental Task Ability in Students based on Electroencephalography Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The characterization of brain function during cognitive activity is gaining interest over the years. Electroencephalography (EEG) is extensively used in the medical field, cognitive science and brain-computer interface research. The brain’s electrical activity under cognitive load can be measured by electrodes placed on the scalp, and the observed signal is called EEG or brain wave. The cognitive load may be reading a book, listening to an online class, solving arithmetic problems or performing motor imagery functions. The ability of a person can be analyzed with the help of machine learning and signal processing techniques. In this paper, the EEG signals are taken from the Physionet database are analyzed. The signals were recorded from 36 students performing mathematical tasks. Different temporal, frequency and wavelet features are extracted using different signal processing techniques. Later, the features are classified using linear discriminant analysis (LDA), artificial neural networks (ANN), and random subspace classifier (RSC). The performance parameters obtained from the RSC classifier are 89.9123% accuracy, 99.4% precision, 92.8819% recall and 84.4664% F_score. The experimental outcome shows that the RSC classifier can better characterize brain activity under mental cognitive conditions.

articleTitle: Social media monitoring using ELK Stack
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Analyzing data in real-time and processing them online has been an important aspect when coming into social media monitoring. This helps to understand the current trends, political scenarios all over the world and most importantly for the purpose of data collection. When viewing from an organizational perspective, offline data analysis can seem to be more productive when data collection happens to be a onetime process. But the current researches require real-time data analysis but still faces various challenges when continuous data fetching disrupts and affects the overall efficiency of the process. This paper demonstrates a solution to effectively address the challenges of real-time analysis using an ELK (Elastic search, Log stash and Kibana) stack which can be used as a SIEM for small scale organization (with various limitations) where logs are taken from Social media platforms (Twitter), analyzed, processed and conclusions are derived from them.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Modelling and Controller Design for Non-ideal DC-DC Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: In this paper, modelling of fractional order non-ideal dc-dc buck converter based on state space averaging technique is proposed. The unique feature of the proposed approach is that the uncertainties in the energy storage components such as inductor and capacitor are also taken into consideration while carrying out the fractional order modelling. Further, fractional order internal model controller is designed using fractional order filter for the fractional order model of a non-ideal dc-dc buck converter. The final controller can be expressed as a series combination of fractional order proportional integral derivative controller, fractional order integrator and a fractional order low pass filter. An extensive comparison of the set point tracking and robustness with the existing techniques of controller design is a testimony to the efficacy and robustness of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Star identification in night sky images using mobile phone camera
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Stars in the night sky are dim light sources. This makes it difficult to capture the details of the night sky using small, low aperture camera sensors, such as those used in mobile phones. Therefore, processing must be done to correctly identify stars in an image captured from a mobile phone, such that the resultant image depicts clearly visible stars with a high signal-to-noise ratio. Existing literature primarily focus on astrophotography using Digital Single-Lens Reflex camera devices (DSLR), which have larger sensors and are kept stationary using mounts such as a tripod. There are very few research works pertaining to astrophotography using mobile phone cameras, due to the lower processing power and the inconvenience to keep a mobile phone stationary during image acquisition. Techniques involving machine learning need a large dataset of preprocessed photos of the night sky. Such a dataset is not publicly available for research. In this work, we develop a novel approach for star identification, enhancement and image stacking using image processing techniques, in order to derive plausible results for night sky images taken from a smartphone sensor. Image enhancement pipelines for three different scenarios have been designed, namely for pure night sky images, night sky images with peripheral objects and burst shot images of the night sky. The results observed are promising and the proposed approach has a potential to be employed for night sky enhancement in mobile phones.

articleTitle: A Heuristic Approximation Algorithm to Design Power and Area Efficient FIR Filters in the Canonic Signed Digit Space
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper introduces a heuristic algorithm that approximates the filter coefficients to the neighbouring values, which have a larger number of zeros in the canonical signed digit (CSD) representation. This approximation increases the number of zeros in the CSD represented filter coefficients so that the realization of the resultant filter requires a reduced number of non-zero partial products in its multipliers, which in turn helps to reduce the area and power consumption of the digital filters. The proposed approach makes sure that the filter performances are maintained within the given limits, and the linear phase property of the filter is preserved. The advantages of the proposed algorithm are demonstrated by designing approximated FIR filters using the algorithm and by analyzing its area and power consumptions and output parameters.

articleTitle: Area efficient implementation of short length QC-LDPC codes for Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communication (URLLC) application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper presents an area efficient implementation of short block length and low rate Quasi cyclic (QC)-Low Density parity check code (LDPC) encoder for binary input additive white Gaussian noise channel (BIAWGN) targeting the Ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) application. The stringent prerequisites like ultra-high reliability and lesser latency have made URLLC applications most critical feature of the 5G wireless communication. In the proposed architecture the dual diagonal encoding is used to generate the codeword. The primary building block in the dual diagonal encoding is the barrel shifter, which performs the cyclic shift operations. Thus, it occupies larger part of area next to the memory blocks. This works aims at drastically reducing the number of barrel shifters using hardware sharing technique. The implementation of the encoder for short length code is done in Xilinx Virtex-7 FPGA platform. The simulation results show that the proposed architecture can reduce the number of multiplexers in the encoder architecture by 37%, thus considerably reducing the area compared to the existing architectures.

articleTitle: IPMSM Drive with Interleaved Bidirectional Converter for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) is one of the most commonly used electric vehicle (EV) traction motors due to many of its desirable features like high-power density and better performance. The frontend interleaved bidirectional DC-DC converter in IPMSM drive circuit can further enhance the performance of the circuit along with stepping-up the battery voltage. The front-end bidirectional converter allows bidirectional power flow and thus, the battery gets charged during regenerative braking of the motor. The interleaved converter allows ripple reduction and reliability enhancement. The current sharing in the interleaved converter also reduces the size and the weight of the inductors. The converter operation automatically shifts from boost mode to buck and vice-versa. The DC link voltage control and the motor control allows the motor to have better static and dynamic characteristics as required for the EVs. The space vector modulated direct torque control (SVMDTC) is used for the voltage source inverter to control the motor with lesser parameter dependence and reduced ripples in torque. Hence, an IPMSM drive for a four wheeler battery electric vehicle is designed and the simulation results are analyzed.

articleTitle: Smart Bridges Based on Bridge Information Modelling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Bridge structures are considered to be the very vulnerable part of civil transportation system that affect directly the public safety and economy. The maintenance of these bridges is many times disregarded in developing counties like India due to lack of maintenance fund, scarcity of experts to rectify problems and so many other reasons. Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) is a method for the diagnosis of damage based on periodically collected data from sensors placed on the structure that lead to characterize the damage and to maintain the health status of the structure. Sufficient expert knowledge is essential for an adequate solution of SHM tasks and Artificial Intelligence (AI) is now being focused on this tasks. Bridge Information Modelling (BrIM) is another digital application in bridge construction industry, which stores and updates the data beyond the design process, enabling engineers with relevant information to carryout fabrication, construction, and maintenance. In this paper a conceptual strategy to integrate the three digital techniques, SHM, AI and BrIM for developing smart bridges for smart cities is proposed.

articleTitle: Cost Analysis of a Smart Home Energy Management System-A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Bilateral communication facilities between the utility and consumer using smart meter infrastructure enables active participation of residential buildings in demand side management. In this paper, a home energy management system (HEMS) is proposed which optimally schedules the smart home appliances and minimizes the electricity cost. A case study of the proposed methodology has been carried out by adopting the present TOU pricing rates and feed in tariff rates of Kerala State Electricity Board. An appliance operation is modelled in terms of uninterruptible sequence phase for a given load profile with an aim to minimize the electricity cost considering energy requirement and user preference constraints. A mixed integer programming-based optimization algorithm is used for scheduling of smart home appliances and the schedule is generated using IBM ILOG CPLEX optimization solver. Cost comparisons have been done for different cases considering changes in season and the savings have been calculated with and without solar generation for the specimen building under study. The computational study revealed percentage savings were minimum for user preferred schedule.

articleTitle: Open-Circuit Switch Fault-Tolerant Half-Bridge LLC Resonant Converters for Satellite Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Highly efficient and highly reliable power converters are required for satellite power system. LLC converters are highly efficient due to Zero Voltage Switching (ZVS) property. The aim of this paper is to improve the reliability of LLC converters by resolving Open-Circuit Fault (OCF) in MOSFET switches. Open-Circuit Fault detection method based on monitoring the average voltage across resonant capacitor and the remedial action which will make the converter continue to work after fault occurrence are proposed. Open-Circuit Fault-Tolerant LLC Half Bridge Converter is simulated in LTSpice XVII to verify its operation under fault conditions.

articleTitle: New Mixed Model Order Reduction Approach for Linear System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: In this article, a new approach for reducing the model of a higher-order system is proposed. The method presented is a mixture of two mathematical methodologies for reducing the high order models. In the given process, stability equation method (SEM) is first used in both numerator and denominator for a certain order and then differentiation method (DM) is applied to reduce it to the desired lower order system. The efficiency and accuracy of this technique is illustrated by different numerical examples. The important benefit of the proposed technique is that it ensures the stability in the low order system and necessary features of the large-scale system. The superiority of the proposed method is observed by comparison of the responses of the both the higher-order and lower-order systems. The performance of the higher-order model and reduced-order model is also compared in terms of error indices like integral time absolute error (ITAE), integral absolute error (IAE), and integral square error (ISE). Finally, the effect of time delay on the closed-loop model of the original and reduced-order model is verified.

articleTitle: Hot Carrier Effect on Base Resistance of SiGe Heterojunction Bipolar Transistors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: In this paper, hot carrier effect on the base resistance of SiGe HBTs is investigated with TCAD simulations. The methods including circle impedance method, semicircle linearisation method and modified circle impedance method are adopted to analyse the base resistance variations. From the analysis, modified circle impedance method is found to be the most accurate one. In all these methods, an increase in base resistance is observed with increased hot carrier rate, which is mainly due to the generation of non-ideal base current. The hot carrier effect on base resistance for different bias voltages is also investigated in this work.

articleTitle: A set of novel stress tests for high dynamic NavIC/GPS receiver software with RF signal input, observations and mitigation strategies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receivers are used in launch vehicles for aiding inertial navigation systems for improving the navigation accuracy. A GNSS receiver capable of decoding signals from both Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC) and Global Positioning System (GPS) constellations is a suitable candidate for launch vehicles. In addition to the RF subsystems and other hardware components, a GNSS receiver houses an intricate software catering to various functional requirements. In this paper, we are presenting a set of novel stress tests for the GNSS receiver software which will be carried out on the target hardware with actual RF signal input. The tests are designed to excite hidden problems if any in the critical areas of the software which may not be excited during conventional software testing. Four different stress tests are presented in this paper. The test results are analyzed and some peculiar observations which are not seen during normal testing are detected. The problems are critically analyzed and the root cause are found out. The test cases are repeated after updating the software and the performance is evaluated.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Various 32-bit Hybrid Adders using Verilog
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Area, Power and Delay optimizations are the challenges in current digital IC design. Processors which are being currently used require adder units. In this work, different type of 32-bit VLSI adders will be studied and their design implementation will be done. Some of the adders were designed using 3-2 compressor. Some of the 32-bit hybrid adders is proposed by using differing types of combination of adders and logic. The combination includes parallel prefix adders like Kogge-Stone adder (KSA), Brent-Kung adder (BKA), Ladner-Fischer adder (LFA) and Han-Carlson adder (HCA). Two 64-bit hybrid adders is designed by analyzing the performance of the 32-bit designed hybrid adders and by selecting the best 32-bit adders. Analysis of the adder performance can be done in terms of Area (Number of LUT s), Delay (nS) and Power (W) analysis is performed with the help of Xilinx ISE 14.7, a Verilog synthesis software and implementation of the same using Verilog HDL family Spartan-6 selecting device XC6SLX16 choosing grade speed -3.

Author Keywords: Ladner-Fischer adder (LFA) and Parallel prefix adders

articleTitle: SnO2 Thin Film Coated Fiber Optic VC Sensor based on Intensity Modulation Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: In this work, an evanescent wave-based fiber-optic sensor is developed utilizing tin oxide (SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) as the sensing layer for detecting volatile Compounds (VC). The optical and morphological characteristics of the proposed SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layer are investigated using an ellipsometer and Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM). VCs such as acetone, ammonia, and ethanol was chosen in the present investigation, and their sensing characteristics are probed with a concentration range of 0-300 ppm. The experimental results illustrate the proposed sensor exhibits maximum sensor response towards ammonia with optimum linearity than other VCs. The sensor’s maximum sensor response and sensitivity towards ammonia are 13.5 % @ 300 ppm and 20.3 counts/ppm, respectively. Further, the prototype of the proposed sensor is developed, and its output characteristics are analyzed in terms of current.

articleTitle: Cross Spectral Image Registration for Fever Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: An infrared thermal imaging system can screen large groups of people quickly, non-intrusively and with a high level of confidence in spotting febrile subjects. A thermal imaging system must identify individuals with a body core temperature above 38<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">◦</sup>C to effectively do this. Conventionally, this is per-formed using thermal imaging cameras in the Long Wave Infra Red (LWIR) region. But the issue with most of these systems is that it fails to read the temperature at the inner eye canthi, which is the ideal location on the face for fever detection. This is owing to the lack of distinguishing features that are available on a thermal image. Hence, in this paper, an attempt is made to read the temperature at the inner eye canthus by first detecting the eye region by running the Viola - Jones Haar Cascade algorithm over the visible images, in a popular synchronized visible and thermal face dataset. Subsequently, this identified region of interest in the visible image is registered against its corresponding thermal image using the ORB algorithm to locate the eye canthus area on the thermal image. Experimental results analysed in this paper proves that a read out of the temperature at this pixel location can be a sufficiently accurate estimate of the core body temperature of the subject being screened.

articleTitle: Dual Stepped Line Impedance Antenna for 8 GHz Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The utility of compact design electronics as per famous moors law exerts a great pressure for compact size communication devices development. A patch antenna is one of the most compact forms of antenna used in day-to-day communication, the compactness of any radiating device is a function of its electrical length rather than its physical length. Several concepts have been examined by different researchers but most of them suffer destitute VSWR, deprived radiation resistance and narrow bandwidth. We can change the electrical as well as physical length of any patch antenna by the help of a stepped impedance structure. In this manuscript, we are presenting three patch antennas first one is a single steeped impedance structure with simple feed and rectangular feed line on the other hand 2nd and 3rd designs are dual stepped impedance structures along with steeped feeding technique, in 2nd design we even introduced variable-width steeped structure as compare of 3rd design, having symmetrical steeped width throughout. In the second design we get the best return loss of -52.11 dB at a center frequency of 3 GHz with an improvement of 122% in bandwidth at lower frequency range and 373.7% improvement in bandwidth at the higher range of frequency along with improvement in the gain of 10.49 dB higher than the 1st design at a higher frequency range of 7.4 GHz, we are also able to get circular polarization at 7.4 GHz with an axial ratio of 0.30 dB.The proposed design with and without the introduction of Stepped Impedance parameter especially dual stepped impedance structure with variable steeped line width gives us a glimpse of changing Stepped Impedance parameters improves the gain, bandwidth and axial ratio for multiband application of 5G communication.

articleTitle: Design and Numerical Analysis of a Compact Microstrip Antenna Sensor for Wireless Body Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The design and analysis of wearable, reshaped rectangular patch antenna with resonant frequency of 2.5 GHz is proposed. The proposed antenna can be used as a microstrip sensor for wearable applications, which is made flexible and compact by using Arlon AD 1000 with thickness 1.6 mm and high dielectric constant 10.2, as the dielectric substrate. The miniaturization is further achieved by reshaping the rectangular patch which makes the overall dimensions of antenna as 25x25x1.6 mm3. Using the Ansys High-Frequency Structure Simulator software, various parameters like return loss, gain, VSWR, radiation efficiency and directivity are examined and validated using finite element approach. Proposed antenna exhibits a gain of 2.4275 dB, -25.6686 dB return loss, -10 dB bandwidth of 123 MHz, and directivity of 3.2742 dB, according to the simulation findings. Because of its compact design and flexibility, the proposed antenna can be employed as a microstrip sensor in Wireless Body Area Network applications.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Simulation Environment for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Providing security to the IoT system is very essential to protect them from various attacks. Such security features include credential management to avoid hard-coding of credentials in web applications, key management for secure inter-device communication and assignment of trust score to the devices based on various parameters. This work contains the design and implementation details of an open source simulation environment with credential management, key management and trust score calculation features. In credential management, credentials are sent to the target device which is then stored in a JSON file. Web application in the device makes use of these credentials for authentication. In key management, X.509 certificate and private key file are generated. They are used for secure message communication using a session key that is secretly exchanged between the devices. For trust score calculation, parameters are collected from the device. Feedback parameters given by other devices are also sent to the centralised server. The dynamic weighted average model is applied to the trust values derived from these parameters to get the trust score of the device. In addition to the design, the source code of our simulation environment is also made publicly available so that researchers can alter and extend its capabilities.

articleTitle: Design Methodology of Solid State C-Band Transponder for Radar Calibration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: C Band Tracking Radars play a pivotal role in tracking ISRO launch vehicles. The real time trajectory data of the launch vehicle provided by the Radars is used for Range Safety decision making process. Calibration of Radars is highly essential since any inaccuracy in the tracking data will reflect as error in Instantaneous Impact Point of the Vehicle, which can result in a wrong decision. Hence, periodic calibration of Radars needs to be carried out to ascertain the Radar accuracy specifications. Of the various techniques available to calibrate Radars, satellite based calibration is found to be the most accurate and advantageous. Satellite based Radar calibration is carried out in conjunction with Transponder onboard the satellite. The performance of the Transponder in space environment is very important for this application. This paper outlines the design methodology adopted for the development of highly reliable Solid State C Band Transponder (SCBT) which is the onboard segment in satellite. SCBT, developed in a highly innovative approach has been successfully flown in SARAL and Resourcesat-2A satellites and is regularly used for Radar calibration.

articleTitle: Decentralized Control of a Slow Moving Mobile Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: In this paper, motion control of slow moving Mobile Manipulators (MM) using decentralized control method is discussed. Slow moving robots are used for applications which require more accuracy, robustness, and reliability so that they can be used in hazardous environments which are unsafe for humans. For proper control, these manipulators have to track the reference trajectory with a constant heading angle and velocity while avoiding the manipulator singularities. In this paper, the movable-platform and the manipulator are considered as two different subsystems and separate kinematic models are developed. By introducing the platform mobility, the singularities of the manipulator can be avoided by keeping its leading configuration in the tracking process, and thus solves the problem of redundancy of the system. Two separate controllers are designed for the movable-platform and the manipulator, and these two controllers are related using the velocities between the two subsystems. Lyapunov approach is used to develop the control law which ensures the asymptotical stability of the system. Effectiveness of the proposed controllers is evident from the simulation results. The analysis of manipulability measure indicates that the MM is capable of doing the task without singularities.

articleTitle: Voltage Profile Improvement of a Multi Microgrid Interconnection Scheme using Synchronverters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The conventional grid is gradually transitioning from its traditional unidirectional flow structure to a distributed and bidirectional one. Microgrids have emerged as a crucial entity in this regard. It consists of a number of Distributed Energy Resources working in a co-ordinated manner within clearly defined electrical boundaries to supply the load. One of the main shortcomings of microgrids is the intermittent nature of its sources. There has been tremendous research in the area of Energy Storage Systems (ESSs) to overcome this issue. However, they have limitations like high maintenance costs, disposal issues, etc. The above issues can be addressed using interconnected microgrids. Energy deficiency in one microgrid can be met by an interconnected neighbor. However, due to a large number of sources, maintaining the required voltage profile at the Point of Common Coupling (PCC) and the load bus will be challenging. This paper presents voltage and frequency controlled synchronverters to improve the voltage profile of a multi microgrid interconnection scheme. Modelling and simulations are done in the MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: A Survey of Metadata Retrieval through Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Due to increasing popularity of videos, video sharing platforms play an important role for millions of content creators to watch videos online. Online content publishing platforms such as YouTube, Facebook and Twitch allows content creators to monetize their posted contents/videos. In which metadata such as title, tag, thumbnail, etc. plays a key role in promoting videos. Most of the digital contents are popular due to the interaction between the content creators and YouTube viewers through their owned channels. The sentiment of each metadata is empirically examined for live streaming, which is spread over 25,000 channels containing across 7 million videos. Metadata which impact the video’s view count are number of subscribers, day one view count, video thumbnail, keywords, Google hits, video category, title’s upper-case letters count and length of the title. These features are mainly used to find the popularity and trendiness of a video. Popularity of a digital content or a video is increased by optimizing metadata after a video is posted. This paper focuses on extracting and analysing the metadata from a video which is then followed by a decision making on the video content. Sentiment analysis is used for such a classification.

articleTitle: Patch-based All Convolutional Neural Network Model for Classification of Benign and Malignant Mammograms
