publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the deadly diseases affecting middle-aged women. Early detection and accurate diagnosis are needed to improve the survival rate of the patients. Digital mammograms are one of the most frequently used techniques for helping early breast cancer detection. Radiologists face challenges for correctly diagnosing breast cancer as they have to examine many mammogram images daily. A computer-aided diagnosis (CAD)system is required to detect abnormalities as early as possible. The present study developed a deep learning model to differentiate malignant from benign tissues using mammograms collected from MIAS, INBreast, and DDSM datasets. As these images contain noise, Contrast limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE) is used to preprocess the images. Then, mammographic segmentation for removing unnecessary background from a mammogram image is carried out. Then, these images passed to Multiscale All Convolution Neural Network(MACNN) to classify a mammogram into benign or malignant. This model has achieved a classification accuracy of 81%.In this study, improvement of the MACNN model, a patch-based MACNN, the proposed model learns more features than MACNN and has earned a classification accuracy of 88%.This model has better classification accuracy than other models ResNet50 and U-net model.

articleTitle: Comparison of GSEIM with Simulink with respect to simulation speed
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: GSEIM (General-purpose Simulator with Explicit and Implicit Methods) is a simulation platform for solving ordinary differential equations that arise from a schematic diagram of a system. GSEIM offers a graphical environment based on the GNU Radio package, a C++ solver, a Qt-Python based plotting facility, enabling the user to create and edit reusable system models. MATLAB-Simulink is a graphical programming environment that includes a wide range of libraries for modelling and simulating multi-domain systems, which are extensively used in industry and academia. Both Simulink and GSEIM follow block modelling that can make use of implicit and explicit solvers for numerical simulation of plant and controller models. In this work, time domain simulations of open-loop and closed-loop drives of induction motor and permanent magnet synchronous motor drives are performed using both GSEIM and Simulink. The relevant results of machine variables obtained in GSEIM are first benchmarked with Simulink results, and then their simulation speeds are compared. Identical mathematical equations are used in the model development and simulations are run with similar solver settings. For the examples considered here, it is found that GSEIM simulations run faster by a factor of 2 to 4 than Simulink.

articleTitle: SPV Panel Hotspot Thermal Profile Modeling and Characterization with Active Cooling Employing CAD Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Hotspots are high-temperature zones that deteriorate the solar panel material, decreasing the reliability and reducing solar panel conversion efficiency if not taken care of immediately. This paper studies the hotspots thermal profiles with and without suppressing and mitigation techniques to overcome the panel inefficiency using the Solid-Works CAD simulator. The spread of the hotspot takes a long time, allowing taking necessary action to prevent damage. The proposed simulation can prevent the generation of hotspots on solar panels, which leads to a decrease in the panel’s efficiency. This study also represents the hotspot temperature profile on air and hard water coolants concerning the time.

articleTitle: Design of an Optimized Controller for Docking System for Space Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Autonomous docking is a technology used for current space programs, which includes missions such as resupply and repair to the International Space Station (ISS) and space exploration of the Mars, Moon etc. For this docking system, Servo motor design is a main part which includes the modeling of BLDC motor and designing a compensator for meeting the docking requirements. The compensation scheme includes PI controller in the plant to meet the plant requirements. For controlling the engine a Brushless DC torque motor is used. The system along with the compensator forms a closed loop system. It can be concluded from the step response that the compensated system ready for motion control for fine alignment and docking of spacecrafts. An optimization problem is formulated whose objective is to find a parameter value that reduces the error between the plant and model outputs. Design of Controller using PID tuner, Trial and error method and Genetic Algorithm are considered. A comparison study is conducted to analyze the best and optimized method. MATLAB/SIMULINK is used as the simulation tool to evaluate the entire behavior of the system.

articleTitle: Investigation of Choice of State Space for Reinforcement Learning Based Battery Scheduling in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper models the battery scheduling problem in a microgrid as multi-stage decision process. A Reinforcement Learning(RL) algorithm named Q-learning is used to solve this problem. Even though RL has been applied for scheduling of Microgrids, there has not been any study investigating the choice of state space. Appropriate choice of state space can reduce the computation time and help in finding the adequate schedule. In this paper, we investigate the choice of state space and action space.

articleTitle: A holistic approach towards detection, tracking, and recognition of face
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: To detect and track the face in a complex environment is still challenging due to variations in speed, illumination, occlusion, rotation, scaling, pose, and imposters. Therefore, a computationally efficient model for face and facial parts detection/tracking is proposed in this work. A deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) based model is designed to detect the face and track it in the successive frames using a point-tracker. The DCNN is developed by re-designing the AlexNet network and tune the weights corresponding to the new classes. A shallow architecture is designed to recognize the face by utilizing hand-craft features and proposed a new distance feature. This model achieves a relative improvement of ~8% over the baseline models. To evaluate the performance of the proposed model, five image databases are used, i.e., the ORL face database, Yale face database, JAFFE database, CK, and the LNMIIT database. The proposed models achieved significant detection and recognition accuracy at a low computation time.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Classifiers of MR Brain Tumor Images on Various Datasets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Life is very precious to everyone. Now, the world is suffering a lot with different kinds of diseases which are trying to evacuate the human species from the planet. So the incorporation of technology in medical field is needed. This helps the clinicians to take fast decisions regarding the treatment because of the improvement in diagnosis methods. This paper aims to compare the performance of various classification algorithms implemented to classify various regions present in the Magnetic Resonant Images (MRI) of brain tumor affected human brain images. Also this paper tries to compare performance using different metrics on various datasets. The aim of the paper is to finally highlight the best algorithm available among the set of algorithms which are taken for comparison. Although different modalities of medical imaging were existed, this paper is taken the MR Imaging of tumor affected brain since it provides high detail of tumor. This work opted accuracy and dice score as the metrics to compare the performance since majority of the work under consideration had used the same metrics. As a conclusion this study states that the detection of tumor in brain using Fuzzy C Means, K Means Clustering and graph cut Algorithms yields better accuracy and Deep LSTM model with N4ITK and Gaussian filters is better in terms of dice score.

articleTitle: Sensor-less Vector Control of Surface PM Synchronous Motor Using Reduced -Order Cubature Kalman Filter Based Estimator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: In this work design and simulation study of a reduced order Cubature Kalman Filter (CKF) observer for position and speed estimation of Surface PM Synchronous Motor is discussed. The application of CKF for sensor-less vector control of PM Synchronous motor is recently reported in literature. In the reported work a fourth order system is consider. In this work the system order is reduced to third order. This is done by using the decupling nature of the system in terms of stator currents. Here two similar type of third order system is designed based on the two stator currents. The CKF algorithm will switch between the two third order systems for consecutive current samples. As a result, at a time only one third order CKF algorithm is to be executed. This will effectively reduce the system to a third order system and computational requirement is also reduces considerable. As CKF is relatively complex algorithm, so order reduction is essential in view of real-time implementation possibility of CKF algorithm. Simulation steady of the proposed drive is carried out in MATLAB. Simulation results establish the fact that performance of the proposed reduced order CKF observer is comparable to full order CKF observer.

articleTitle: An Overview on Handling Anti Forensic Issues in Android Devices Using Forensic Automator Tool
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The digital forensic methods and tools have become a very important part for the investigators. During the investigation on Cyber-crimes, collection of the digital evidences during the case is the vital part. Mobile forensics being an important domain in digital forensics which includes acquisition of the data and analysing it to recover the digital evidences in a forensic manner. But there are some of the anti-forensic issues faced during the investigation. The Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT) investigates an incident for creation of a detailed description on how the crime was executed and makes a report on the incident. This paper focuses on how the antiforensic issues can be handled in android mobiles and how the improvements took place in the field of mobile forensics and data acquisition. This paper also aims to introduce how the files are acquired during the investigation, what are the techniques and tools that were used to tamper with the evidence found and how the forensic investigators can identify the data tampered. The solution is proposed for one of the Forensic issue of files that are in encoded format where the encoding of the file is not known, using the SVM Machine Learning technique how it can be achieved.

articleTitle: Regenerative Braking of Switched Reluctance Motor for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Advantages like high efficiency, maximum operating speed, low rotor inertia and ability to operate in all four quadrants make switched reluctance motor (SRM) an option for electric vehicle applications. This paper presents a regenerative braking control strategy with switched reluctance motor. An electric four wheeler is selected for the specified application and SRM motor is chosen for the selected electric vehicle. Further, regenerative braking and control is implemented to the selected motor drive system and the results are obtained.

articleTitle: Virtual Smart Canteen System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The proposed work targets to solve the issues faced by students in a university canteen by integrating a mobile application for online food ordering, together with an application for vacant seat detection for hassle-free seating space finding, food recommendation and sentiment analysis features making food ordering process in a university canteen more convenient and efficient. Our proposed system consist of three main modules which are Vacant seat detection module, Recommendation module and Feedback analysis module. We have used TensorFlow detection model for our vacant seat detection. We’ve used this model to detect people in canteen and calculate the available seats. This helps students, faculty and staff to be aware of the estimated number of canteenâs customers in real-time. To implement recommendations module, our system uses item-based collaborative filtering. This module give five similar food item based on the similarity of food items. For feedback analysis module, we analyzed the sentiment of the comments received on a particular food item. A positive review is defined as a score of 4 or 5, negative rating of 1 or 2 can be considered and review with a rating of 3 is considered neutral. This is used to know the overall rating of food. All three module combined can definitely help students/faculty to save their time as well as help canteen staff members to manage everything for effectively.

articleTitle: Space syntax analysis of Total connectivity through the evolution of Bag Bazar Street, Kolkata (1746-2020)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The status of urbanized areas has recently deteriorated as the need for people and goods transportation has grown. Bag Bazar Street is one of Kolkata's three main thoroughfares and is known as the grandmother road in the ekanto poribar (joint family), making it an ideal case study location. This paper aims to investigate the complete connectedness of Bag Bazar Street using urban morphology and space syntactic analysis. Syntactic space studies help investigate diverse historical sources to produce a cohesive account of urban spatial configuration by developing and evaluating hypotheses about urban mobility features and linkages across history. The research analyzes urban space and space syntax, which offers compelling opportunities as an exuberant proliferation of spaces. The city plan is critical in examining the historical link between metropolitan and urban life. When determining an area's level of connectivity, the aspect of spatial integrity must be taken into account. An axial map with a connection map frames essential findings in the study. Any plan for urban revitalization or smart city development requires a thorough understanding of the spatial characteristics and phases that define modern cities and the relationship between the two. Consequently, this study aims to confirm the degree of connectivity of Kolkata's Bag Bazar street as an input for future Smart city development.

articleTitle: Design, Fabrication, Analysis and Testing of a Planar Inductor on a High Frequency Buck Converter using SiC Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper presents the design, FEM simulation, analysis, and experimental validation of a high frequency planar inductor prototype. The planar inductor design steps are shown in a detailed form. The planar inductor performance is also simulated. It is finally tested in a synchronous buck converter on a laboratory built Double Pulse Test (DPT) board. Detailed investigations on the planar inductor include electromagnetic and thermal studies at high frequencies in the range of 100 kHz to 1 MHz. The variation of the inductance value with increase in frequency is also observed. The experimental and predicted results have remarkable mutual agreement.

articleTitle: An efficient approach for spammer detection on Twitter and their behavior analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Twitter is the 4th most popular social networking site and almost 353 million are using Twitter worldwide. The main problems faced by Twitter users are spam, malicious automation, and platform manipulation. Twitter’s developer API is exposed to make it easy to interact. So, the anti-spam system on Twitter is known by spammers. Here, we are using some features that are related to account details of Twitter users with two different data sets having one lakh data for each. We propose a method to classify spam and non-spam users using five machine learning classifiers. We evaluated the performance using accuracy, precision, and recall. Then we are proposing a fuzzy-based approach for user behavior analysis, inspired by the Five-factor model of behavior theory. Only a few works are discussing the behavior of the spammer, and we found that there exists a relationship between the traits of a person and spamming.

articleTitle: Performance study of Capacitor Clamped Multilevel Inverter fed Induction Motor Drive for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper focusses an improvised AC drive for Electric Vehicle (EV) application using induction motor. It is executed by a multilevel inverter by using three level space vector modulation techniques. Multilevel inverter has low distortion and total harmonic distortion of voltages at output related to other inverter topologies. SVM produces the required gate drive waveform and the inverter used is taken as solo element and can joint various switching states. In this paper a better technique is implemented for the electric vehicle control using induction motor drives with multilevel inverter system. The performance analysis of the proposed system has been done using MATLAB/SIMULINK software.

articleTitle: Parameter Independent Backstepping Controller for Bidirectional Buck-Boost Converter in DC Grid Battery Interface with CPL
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Accurate voltage regulation and power management with non-linear stabilizing controllers are required for reliability and stability of standalone renewable powered dc microgrids. Here, a modified backstepping design approach is utilized to design a stabilizing non-linear controller for a bidirectional buck-boost converter. The performance of the designed controller is compared with a PI controller. The backstepping controller is inherently stable as it is designed based on Lyapunov stability condition. This parameter independent design improves robustness. The derived control law is devoid of any integral or derivative terms improving speed and simplicity compared to PI controller. It also forms a generalized controller which can be applied to a bidirectional buck boost converter with any specified parameters and can be tuned to any desired closed loop performance.

articleTitle: Torque Ripple Reduction and Speed Control of PMSM Using Fuzzy Logic for Propulsion Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous machines are utilized for several applications in electric vehicles, industries,aerospace, domestic appliances due to highly efficient nature. The foremost problem thatmarks the working of PMSMs is torque and speedripples. Voltage feedback field weakening control is the prevalentmethod to diminish ripples as it is robust and simple since it won’talter in agreement with machine parameters. In this paper for fast speed dynamics and fewer ripples fuzzy controller is used and system has been developed using a PI and fuzzy logic controller. The results are analysed and an FFT analysis has also been donein MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Steering Angle Estimation for an Autonomous Car
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The number of traffic accidents and fatalities has increased dramatically in the modern period. Every minute, a catastrophic traffic accident occurs in India, and every hour, 16 people die on Indian roadways. The driver’s errors such as negligence, drowsiness, and wrong driving decisions lead to advancement of the autonomous vehicle industry. Such a dire situation necessitates decision-making approaches that are both computationally efficient and quick to respond. A convolutional neural network (CNN) model could be used to map the raw pixels from a single front-facing camera directly to calculate the steering commands.In this paper, a CNN methodology has been implemented for the estimation of steering angles. Here the concepts of deep learning and convolutional neural networks are applied to teach the computer to drive car autonomously. The revolutionary aspect of CNNs is that characteristics are automatically learned from training samples. Because the convolution procedure captures the 2D aspect of images. Images from the cameras (input to CNN) are fed into a CNN which then computes a proposed steering command. The command thus obtained from CNN is compared with desired command, and the CNN weights are changed accordingly to get the CNN output closer to the desired output. Back propagation algorithm is used for weight adjustments. Once trained, the network can generate steering angles from the video images of a single center camera. The data collection is performed using Udacity self-driving car simulator designed by Unity (game engine). The CNN model is able to learn meaningful road features from training signal (steering alone).

articleTitle: “Implementation of Testing Accreditation Analytical Framework for Higher Education System.”
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Generating document is a frustrating experience in any reputed institution. The institutions should maintain significant and direct documents which can be used as evidence for quality. The Manual documentation process is extremely tedious and time-consuming. The paper presents the working of a developed application which will give a chance to minimize the institute work and makes the Accreditation process easier by conducting an indirect survey using grade points. The points are gathered from the head of the department based on the exit survey, placements, additional programs, parents’ feedback and course end surveys. The purpose of the developed application is to Test the Quality of the Technical Education Programme assessed by the Accredation Portal where a certificate of accreditation is awarded for a specific Programme. Historically technical institutes should conduct exercises for self-assessing the quality of their programmers on Naac criteria.

articleTitle: Passive Control of Annealing in Polymerase Chain Reaction Using Phase Changing Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: A transient thermal model and analysis of passive control of annealing process in thermal cycling process to be carried out as part of continuous flow Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) is presented. Phase Changing Materials (PCM) are widely used in passive thermal control applications owing to their excellent thermal response during the phase changing process. Thermal system modeling and numerical simulation are performed to elucidate the one-dimensional unsteady sample fluid flow, convective heat transfer in microchannels, and melting of PCM encapsulation in the annealing module of the thermal cycling module. Results are validated with numerical simulations performed for a similar two-dimensional system with enthalpy-porosity method based finite volume solver. Thermal response and heat transfer efficiency of various organic PCMs are compared.

articleTitle: BER-SNR Evaluation using Phase Shift Keying with OSTBC in MIMO Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The fundamental design issue faced by future 5G wireless networks is to solve the enhancing demand of faster communication reliability with limited spectrum and lower power. MIMO diversity addresses the challenge of multipath fading. The system efficacy reduction is due to limited resource availability and impairment of the wireless channels like ISI that must be mitigated. In this work, the performance characterization of MIMO environment is presented. BER comparative analyses is done under Rayleigh’s fading channel with BPSK modulation in comparison to AWGN performances. The model is implemented using MATLAB. Characterization of Eb/No for optimal signal to noise ratio and hence optimize BER and compare BER performances for BPSK (Binary phased shift keying) in MIMO (Multi input multi output) diversity design for 5G infrastructure, to understand MIMO antenna design.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of a Hybrid Islanding Detection Scheme for PV Based Distributed Generators Combining Total Harmonic Distortion and Bidirectional Reactive Power Injection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Distributed Generation (DG) become widely accepted due to their eco-friendly operation. Grid connected operation of DG is inevitable as it helps to transfer the power in both ways. The unintentional disconnection of grid from a grid connected DG causes the DG, to get islanded. As unintentional islanding has a number of drawbacks including even the fatality of working personnel, it should be detected within 2s as per IEEE standards. There are different islanding detection schemes (IDS) in the literature. In this paper a hybrid IDS, combining Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) measurement scheme and Bidirectional Reactive Power Injection (BRPI) is presented. Using MATLAB/SIMULINK software, simulations are carried out for a 50kW Photo Voltaic (PV) based grid connected DG. Results and waveforms are presented.

articleTitle: Parametric Analysis on Charge Scheduling and Pricing of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)

authors.preferredName: Mary Synthia Regis Prabha D M

abstract: This paper intends to propose an optimization oriented charge scheduling with dynamic pricing model. Here, a new Modified Tunicate Swarm Algorithm (M-TSA) model is introduced for optimization. When an EV reaches the Charging station, the EV user chooses the charging type (i.e. fast, slow or medium charging) depending upon his/her requisite. As the consumer’s constraint varies, they are given a dynamic concern to select their charging mode. Generally, when charging EVs, the consumer wants to stay patiently for lengthy hours. This unfavourable effect is ignored with the established scheduling model. Also, the most important constraint hoisted by EV users is the controlled rates for charging. This has also been satisfied in this work by optimizing the charging cost. Finally, parametric analysis is held to confirm the effectiveness of the developed model.

articleTitle: A cellular IoT based sensor system for atmospheric studies using UAVs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of objects or sensors which are interconnected through communication technologies for exchange of information to provide services. Sensors for atmospheric studies can be integrated into a module and mounted on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) and data from these sensors can be uploaded to cloud for real time access. In cases where UAVs are used, most of the papers discuss atmospheric studies or air pollution monitoring through IoT where WiFi module/RF communication module and base stations on ground are used. This limits the range of the studies carried out. The proposed study intends to build a portable sensor system to be mounted on UAV for atmospheric studies and couple the same with cellular IoT using a 4G LTE modem for internet connectivity. The sensors’ data is uploaded to cloud via the cellular networks and accessed anywhere in real time directly from the cloud platform without range limitations. The proposed system does not require Wifi modules or base station on ground thus reducing the hardware complexity. The designed system is capable of measuring temporal data of atmospheric parameters like PM2.5, PM10, Co<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, CO, NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, barometric pressure, temperature periodically along with spatial data: latitude, longitude and altitude.

articleTitle: Achieving Market Segmentation From B2B Insurance Client Data Using RFM & K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: With innumerable players available in the market, it is no secret that the insurance industry is facing the heat of competition, struggling to outperform their rivalries and maintain customer engagement. This can be resultant due to the highly commoditized approach and superficial customer engagement methods. Such inadequate analysis as an end result can cause a performance dip if the insurance providers prioritize merely on cost management model leading to customer dissatisfaction and attrition. Research implications in this study denote overhauling antiquated customer segmentation models and showcasing varied yet smarter perspectives of deriving more reliable insights from data. Thereby, helping businesses to formulate better growth strategies by not missing out on the customer-centric approach. The way forward is to identify best-performing customer groups using RFM techniques and K-means algorithm that add value to the business. The target customers then must be offered personalized product offerings and services to embrace their behavioral needs or requirement. Design marketing campaigns tailor-made to the relevant customer(s) and that would best compliment the target groups. Generic traditional customer segmentation analysis results can be biased or imply lackluster outcomes, misleading, vain attempts try and can even lead to losing high performing customers. The outcomes from this study will aid in ease decision making for businesses by adopting a focused customer-led target market segmentation approach that will make the former easier to timely formulate or launch ideal marketing strategies to efficiently channelize the most relevant customer(s) for a defined set of product offering(s) based on their behavioral attributes.

articleTitle: A Real-Time IoT and Cloud System for Carbon Dioxide Monitoring in Dhaka City's Buildings with Rooftop Garden and without Rooftop Garden
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Carbon dioxide produced by fossil fuel burning, cement manufacture, and deforestation contributes greatly to the greenhouse effect, which is one of the most important consequences of industrialization. The Internet of Things (IoT), wireless communication networks and sensor devices, enables real-time tasks and data interchange in a central server with high-performance and cost-effective components. We design and develop an IoT and cloud-based system to monitor CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> levels in the environment in two separate places in Dhaka city buildings: Rooftop Garden Area (RGA) and Normal Regular Rooftop (NRR) without a garden. The difference in carbon dioxide levels between the two sites varies throughout a number of days. The data is collected in four dayparts: Early Morning (EM), Morning (M), Noon (N), and Afternoon (AN) at three-hour intervals. The MQ-135 gas sensor monitors long-term and large-scale carbon dioxide levels, and the collected data is sent to the Firebase cloud storage using the NodeMCU ESP 8266 12E Wi-Fi module. To ensure that the internet connection is always available and that dummy values are avoided, the system in the network was continuously monitored. Data is collected at 5-minute intervals from the beginning of the morning (6:00 AM) until the end of the afternoon (6:00 PM) to obtain the most accurate value. We took 432 data row points and visualized them using a variety of comparison themes. According to the statistics, the maximum amount of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in a regular rooftop was 568 PPM, whereas the maximum level of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in a rooftop garden area was 443 PPM. That paper developed a very dependable real-time carbon dioxide concentration monitoring system using smart applications. The importance of rooftop gardening in buildings is also discussed in this paper. Veranda gardening on a small scale does not immediately impact the environment, but it does improve air quality and supply adequate oxygen for many people to survive. A typical rooftop's CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> level is always higher than a rooftop with a garden area, according to our findings.

articleTitle: Automated Alert Generation Ensuring Women Safety Using Heartbeat Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: India is a developing country but still India is ranked as 148th country out of 170 in terms of safety of women. There occur many unfortunate events even today. In a developing country like India, this should be seen seriously as it affects the development of the economy and GDP. Fortunately, with developments in technology and advancements, we can try to help be this country a better place for women. There are different cases of harassment, blackmailing, stalking, etc and much more daily taking place to women. There have been many unreported and underreporting cases due to many reasons. To solve these issues there had been a lot of attempts to concern and report the authorities in the view to stop these events. This model proposed has a more advancement of detecting the unfortunate event using heart rate and activity detector, without human intervention and concern the required authorities, with the alert message, to decrease and present any such situation and keep women of our country safe enough to walk alone in streets as per their wish. The present systems available are SHE(Society Harnessing Equipment), VithU app, but the drawback these have is that they require victim intervention to trigger it. Surveys have shown that a person in danger is mostly not able to defend themselves or act right at that moment due to fear and anxiety. So the requirement that needs to be focused on right now is to have an automated alert trigger system which is the novelty of our project here. A miniature system that can collect information on the pulse rate and heartbeat, with a sensor to track activity is what this system will look into and trigger the right action in case it senses danger. The proposed system will also have a push button to trigger the alert manually.

articleTitle: A blockchain-based platform for smart contracts and intellectual property protection for the additive manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Autonomous machine-to-machine interaction with minimal human interference is one of the defining features of cyber-physical systems that are expected to become ubiquitous as the manufacturing industry enters the fourth industrial revolution. Blockchain technology could emerge as a technology that underpins cyber-physical systems because of its various desirable characteristics. This paper describes the design and implementation details of two components of a blockchain-based data model for the additive manufacturing industry. A smart contract framework is proposed for the creation and execution of agreements between design companies and 3D printing companies. It facilitates the verification and automatic enforcement of these contracts. The framework incorporates a dedicated platform for the management of design files for intellectual property (IP) protection-related use cases. This helps to control the usage and distribution of IP, which is a crucial requirement for a data management solution for the industry. The proposed platforms have been implemented using the Ethereum software stack and its advantages and use cases have been explored.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Feasibility Analysis of LVDC System to Retrofit an Existing AC System: Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper describes the proposal for a Low Voltage DC (LVDC) system for a lecture room in an educational institute in Kerala. Paper evaluates the feasibility for retrofitting an existing AC powered system with a new solar-powered LVDC system. At present, power is transmitted in AC form in transmission systems, and hence end-user loads are also powered by AC power. Using DC loads supplied by AC power requires the use of inefficient rectifiers. This proposed system generates DC power from solar panels installed on the rooftop, transmits it to the room in DC form itself, and is ultimately consumed by DC-powered fans and lights. The annual power and energy requirement of the room under consideration are observed and noted. An LVDC system is proposed to meet the required output. The economic feasibility has been evaluated using tools like a Simple Payback Period (SPP) and Net Present Value (NPV), considering the investments in solar panels, DC-powered loads and accessories.

articleTitle: Graph Based Document Model and its Application in Keyphrase Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Graph-based document models, rather than the traditional Bag of Words (BOW) model, have opened the way to efficiently represent documents by capturing syntactic and semantic characteristics from the document. Because a graph is a mathematical model, it may effectively capture the best properties from documents and be utilized for a variety of Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications, as well as simplifying other computations. In a graph model, document terms are represented as nodes, and relationships between those terms are captured and joined together to produce edges, with a weightage based on the extent of the relationship. This work presents a systematic survey of existing graph models, with a focus on node selection, edge selection, and edge weighting factors that are appropriate for diverse NLP applications. Key extraction based on graph models, as well as various ranking algorithms, are also examined. This study shows that graph-based document models play an important role in representing textual documents and assisting with complex NLP tasks.

articleTitle: Supervised Fan Beam Computed Tomography Image Synthesis using 3D CycleGAN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Computed Tomography (CT) images can be obtained using two types of devices; Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) and Fan Beam Computed Tomography (FBCT). CBCT device assists radiotherapy in correcting patient positioning. FBCT images are used to prepare radiotherapy planning. Both CBCT and FBCT devices produce 3D images in which the former has high artefact and noise and a low signal-to-noise ratio relative to the latter. These reasons prevent the use of CBCT for planning and replanning even though CBCT is cheaper and more accessible to obtain than FBCT. Using CBCT for treatment planning instead of FBCT can lead to faster and affordable treatments. This paper proposes a deep learning technique to synthesise FBCT-like images from CBCT images. A supervised 3D CycleGAN is used in this work to learn the mappings between CBCT and FBCT scans of the head and neck (H&N) region. The cycleGAN uses a hybrid loss function that includes cycle consistency, binary cross-entropy, gradient difference, and identity losses. A long skip connection is introduced between input and output layers in the network since the CBCT images are highly correlated to the corresponding FBCT images. The network is trained over the H&N FBCT-CBCT volumetric scans of 21 patients obtained from MVR Cancer Centre & Research Institute. The 3D cycleGAN synthesises FBCT-like images with PSNR of 30.729±2.421 dB, MSE of 103.016±16.745, and SSIM of 0.877±0.040. The quantitative analysis confirms that the proposed cycleGAN outperforms the state-of-the-art CGAN model.

articleTitle: Design of Band-Pass Fir Filter Using Modified Social Group Optimization Algorithm and its Implementation on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for the design of a type-I band-pass Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filter using Modified Social Group Optimization. To achieve better performance in filter response, few modifications were made in the basic SGO algorithm. When compared with the well-known Parks- McClellan (PM) and improved Sine Cosine algorithm, this modified version shows better results in terms of pass-band ripple and stop-band attenuation. Moreover, this paper discusses the hardware implementation aspect of filters in the FPGA platform.

articleTitle: Measurement of chaos and quantum decoherence in H&E stained images of oral epithelium for early detection Oral Submucous Fibrosis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Oral cancer is accountable for 0.3 million deaths annually, and in India a significant factor which adds to this burden is the delayed detection of precancerous states like Oral Submucous Fibrosis (OSF). Histopathological abnormal changes seen in the oral epithelial region is known as dysplasia which is accompanied by abnormal variation in nuclear and cellular size and shape, atypical mitotic figures, and augmented nuclear-cytoplasmic ratio. To diagnose dysplastic changes in histopathological images, computer aided image processing is being used extensively. The present study measured Fractal dimensional, power spectral density and Renyi entropy values of the epithelial nuclei for the different study groups i.e. Normal, OSF (without dysplasia) and OSF (with dysplasia) to understand chaos whereas detection of the number of mitotic figures was done to understand quantum coherence. The analysis were done ImageJ and MATLAB respectively. Fractal dimensional analysis demonstrated significant increase (p<0.0001) in diseased conditions. Renyi entropy analysis, found an increase (p<0.00001) in both the precancerous conditions. The power spectrum decay rate shows increase in chaos from normal to precancerous stage with dysplasia (p=<0.00001) and also between the precancerous conditions (with and without dysplasia (p=0.00028). Mitotic figures were successfully detected using combination of deep blue ratio and contour detection. An enhancement in number of mitotic figures from standard to precancerous condition was observed and hence loss of quantum coherence was established in diseased conditions.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Path Tracking Controllers for Robotaxi Manoeuvres
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Trajectory tracking is a critical task in the area of autonomous vehicles. This paper presents the analysis of pure pursuit, model predictive and linear quadratic regulator control schemes for various scenarios of a Robo-taxi. Critical scenarios required for Robo-taxis are analysed, and a set of manoeuvres are selected for implementation and analysis. Waypoints for the selected trajectories are designed using the MATLAB® Automated Driving Toolbox. These waypoints are used for the local path planning to generate a reference to the selected controllers. The state prediction required for the model based controllers are calculated using a non-linear bi-cycle model. The controller outputs are analysed by defining a set of performance parameters. Simulation experiments are conducted to generate the results and also for the analysis of the controller performance for the defined scenarios. The analysis of results shows that Model Predictive Controller is better than the other controllers.

articleTitle: A solution to power balancing in high renewable penetration power system: Use of Abandoned Generating Units
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The world is drifting towards a renewable dominated power scenario. Among the renewable energy sources, wind power projects are gaining the prominence. In the new energy mix, many conventional paradigms are being redefined. For years, steam turbine time constants which were assumed as constant proved to be no longer constants as the generation schedule varies. With the increased penetration of renewable, conventional power plants are facing threat of shut down. Meanwhile, majority of synchronous machines in these conventional power plants such as thermal and nuclear stations are operated at partial generation schedule between 70 % and 90 %, due to various economic and environmental factors. The shut down of conventional power plants results in abatement of numerous synchronous machines. This work proposes the use of abandoned thermal generating units as synchronous condenser to aid dynamic frequency regulation in a high renewable penetrated power system with varying generation schedule. The synchronous condenser provides momentary active power support following a load change. Simulation studies were carried out under various scenarios of generation schedule and incorporation of synchronous condenser. Obtained results bridges the concepts of varying generation schedule and synchronous condenser and their effect on dynamic frequency regulation of power system has been analysed.

articleTitle: Revocable and Scalable Access to Personal Health Records in a Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: The Personal Health Record (PHR) is one of the most significant models in the information exchange of the health reports, which is frequently extracted from some other third party storing the data, like as the cloud holder. Thus, for the privacy concern purpose of the patients and the users there emerged the promising technique to provide security for the data and its attributes shared among the PHR owners and the users, which is the Attribute Based Encryption (ABE). Yet, there existed issues in this technology for the security provision with adaptable access for the user and owner, scalability in key management, privacy exposure, and user revocation efficacy have been persisted towards the succession of the fine-grained and the cryptographical imposed access control over the data. In such case the paper is proposed upon a framework for a patient-centric control of PHR over the semi-trusted servers of the cloud data, where the encryption of the data can be accessed by multiple authority in a proper ciphertext policy applied over the attribute-based encryption termed as the MA-CP-ABE. Attaining the scalability and fine-grained, the ABE uses the encryption technique to each PHR documents and the data is secured from multiple domains of users and owners which is significantly divided by different terms of PHR in multiple security schemes for affording the key management difficulty in a reduced state. Additionally, a revocable and scalable mechanism is added in the ABE for the patient privacy and security of data sharing which is highly assured. The experimental results and the analytical reports are established which achieves the security, scalability and efficacy of the proposed work.

articleTitle: A study of Change Impact Analysis Techniques based on Requirement Defects during the Software Development Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: One of the major challenges faced by software companies is to produce high-quality software. Quality is not a state but a continuous process, it is critical to produce quality artefact at every stage of software development. Making modifications to software during and after development is a common occurrence. Executing the recommended modifications in software might have negative consequences such as lowering its quality or introducing new problems, which would raise the cost of software maintenance. As a result, a methodical approach to change management is necessary. Change Impact Analysis (CIA) is a method for controlling software modification that has already been implemented. CIA is becoming increasingly essential in various sectors, particularly software development. The objective of this paper is to do an analysis on CIA’s emerging elements, which evaluates the nature of every change request and seeks to integrate such changes into a program in a step-by-step manner. The paper aims to uncover the difficulties and challenges in CIA, current advancements, methodologies and tools in the field as well as the emerging scope of research in this field.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of DFT Based Channel Estimation for Spatial Modulated FBMC-COQAM systems on Multipath Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: This work proposes channel estimation based on Least Square (LS) and Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) in Spatial Modulated FBMC-COQAM system. Initially, LS estimation is done to proceed with the DFT method. It is observed that using the DFT method; improves the performance of the LS method by removing noise outside the Channel Impulse Response (CIR) with the knowledge of maximum CIR in advance. With LS estimation, the channel response is obtained with the transmitted pilot symbols. After interpolation with linear and spline methods, the channel response for all SM FBMC- COQAM blocks is obtained. DFT estimation is then performed. The channel model used is the Typical Urban model proposed by the COST 259 project. The simulation result shows that Mean Square Error (MSE) performance improves approximately by 3 dB compared with LS spline and approximately 7 dB with LS linear at MSE 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> with DFT-based channel estimation. Also, an improvement of approximately 4dB over LS estimation is observed at SER 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. Comparing the proposed system with SM-OFDM, the performance remains the same.

articleTitle: Development of a New Portable Test Station for Remote testing of Inertial Navigation Systems for Launch Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Computer based test stations are inevitable part of every onboard avionic system development and qualification. Currently dedicated industrial computer systems were used for testing the inertial navigation system. They are customized integrated checkout systems that directly connect to the package through the MIL-STD-1553B bus. The movement of checkout along with the testing personnel was a laborious task due to its huge size. This paper describes the development of a new miniaturized portable test station for designer level tests of the navigation system with MIL 1553B interface. It provides a remotely controlled communication interface for testing, calibrating and programming the Inertial Navigation Systems (INS) with minimal movement of test station. It is a computer-based system with an intuitive graphical user interface and can be adapted to different families of processors with 16 or 32-bit word length. The new test station simplified the evaluation process and also the advantage of scalability of the checkout for future developments with new processors.

articleTitle: An Efficient Analysis of E-Commerce Site using Big Data Assisted Modified Learning Strategy based on Novel Customer Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Now-a-days, the tendency of shopping and purchasing products from vendors are totally changed with respect to the development of online shopping services. The logic is briefly called as E-Commerce, in which this port allows the user to register the identity and start purchasing the products based on their needs. This system attracts many corporate and commercial organizations to change their business strategy and start selling their products via online. This paper is intended to design a new approach for supporting both customer and seller ends in clear manner with respect to the adaptation of latest technologies such as Deep Learning, BigData and Mining Schemes. This paper provides a novel analysis to assess the customer recommendations and provide the required details regarding that to the further customer end as well as the seller end to upgrade their purchasing and selling points. The proposed learning principle is called as BigData Assisted Modified Learning Strategy (BMLS), in which it is derived from the mining scheme called Apriori and the Deep Learning approach. This paper survey several literatures to identify the existing problems in this domain and provide a proper resolution to the recommendation system in fine manner. This paper provides a brief discussion on designing ideas of the proposed approach using learning scheme as well as the detailed survey of the literature in further sections. The discussion section of this paper provides a proper summary of the proposed scheme with implementation ideas in proper way with clear specifications. The logic of BigData is applied to handle the huge volume of data in simple way as well as the specific technology provides congestion free data management over the server end.

articleTitle: A Survey on Various Combination of Breast Cancer Biomarkers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Informatics, Communication and Energy Systems (SPICES)
abstract: Cancer, especially breast cancer can be considered as one of the most common life threatening disease now a days. Its growth generally depends on the function of many proteins seen in the serum of human beings. These proteins might be potential bio markers for the earlier detection of cancer and can definitely spread light to the drug effectiveness and evaluation. Even though bio markers like CEA (Carcino Embryonic Antigen) is broadly used to follow up the presence of abnormalities, it is not effectual to depend only on these single bio markers. A pertinent combination of bio markers is undeniably the need of this hour which can veritably aid the early diagnosis of cancer. This study inspects the suitable combination of cancer bio markers identified using various datamining techniques.
